params.name: module
params.description: API module name. One of: account, contract, transaction, block, logs, token, stats, proxy.

params.name: action
params.description: Action to perform within the selected module. Examples: balance, txlist, tokentx, getabi, getsourcecode, getstatus, getblockreward, tokensupply, ethsupply, gasoracle, eth_blockNumber.

params.name: chainid
params.description: Chain ID for Etherscan V2 unified endpoint. Use 10 for OP Mainnet. Not needed when using the legacy api-optimistic.etherscan.io endpoint.

params.name: address
params.description: OP Mainnet address for account or token operations (0x-prefixed).

params.name: contractaddress
params.description: Smart contract address for token or contract operations (0x-prefixed).

params.name: endblock
params.description: End block for range queries (inclusive). Use 99999999 for latest.

params.name: tag
params.description: Block tag for proxy/stats calls. One of: latest, earliest, pending, or a hex block number.

params.name: boolean
params.description: Used with module=account&action=balance for multi-address balance queries. Set to true to enable.

params.name: apikey
params.description: Etherscan API key. Required for most endpoints; obtain at https://optimistic.etherscan.io/myapikey. Can also be passed via the apiKeyAuth security scheme.

items.docs: All Optimism Etherscan API calls are issued against this endpoint. The `module` and `action` query parameters select the operation; additional parameters depend on the module/action pair. For V2 unified access, also pass `chainid=10`.
